features.name: glucose_risk_tier
features.description: Ordinal bucket of plasma glucose into 4 clinically meaningful tiers: normal (<100), pre-diabetic (100-125), diabetic (126-199), severe (>=200 capped). Provides direct threshold splits for tree models.
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes nonlinear glucose thresholds as ordinal integers, enabling single-split decisions at clinically meaningful boundaries.

features.name: bmi_obesity_tier
features.description: Ordinal BMI category: underweight/missing (0, mass<=0), normal (1, 0<mass<25), overweight (2, 25-29.9), obese class I (3, 30-34.9), obese class II+ (4, >=35). Captures nonlinear obesity risk.
features.expected_model_benefit: Converts continuous BMI into clinically meaningful ordinal splits that tree models can leverage directly.

features.name: age_decade_bucket
features.description: Age grouped into decade buckets (20s=0, 30s=1, 40s=2, 50s=3, 60+=4). Captures nonlinear age-related diabetes risk progression.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides ordinal age groupings that align with known decade-level risk increases, enabling efficient tree splits.

features.name: high_parity_indicator
features.description: Binary flag: 1 if number of pregnancies >= 6 (above ~75th percentile), indicating high parity which is associated with gestational diabetes history.
features.expected_model_benefit: Boolean threshold feature that tree models can split on directly to capture high-parity risk group.

features.name: glucose_bmi_interaction
features.description: Product of normalized glucose and BMI deviations from their training means (plas-120.9)*(mass-32.0)/1000. Captures joint metabolic risk where both elevated glucose and high BMI compound risk.
features.expected_model_benefit: Nonlinear interaction term that tree models can split on to identify patients with simultaneously elevated glucose and BMI.

features.name: insulin_missing_flag
features.description: Binary flag: 1 if insulin value is 0 (likely missing/not recorded), 0 otherwise. Zero insulin in non-type-1 diabetics is physiologically implausible and indicates data missingness.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures systematic missingness pattern in insulin that may correlate with measurement context and risk profile.

features.name: log_insulin_nonzero
features.description: Log-transformed insulin level using log1p to handle zeros. Compresses the highly right-skewed insulin distribution for better tree splits.
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces skewness of insulin distribution, enabling more balanced tree splits across the insulin range.

features.name: pedigree_risk_tier
features.description: Ordinal bucket of diabetes pedigree function into 3 tiers: low hereditary risk (<0.3), moderate (0.3-0.7), high (>=0.7). Captures nonlinear genetic predisposition.
features.expected_model_benefit: Converts continuous pedigree score into ordinal risk tiers enabling direct threshold splits on hereditary risk.

features.name: skin_bmi_ratio
features.description: Ratio of skin thickness to BMI. Captures relative subcutaneous fat distribution independent of overall body size. Clipped to handle zero BMI edge cases.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a body composition ratio feature that may reveal fat distribution patterns not captured by BMI alone.

features.name: metabolic_risk_score
features.description: Composite additive score combining normalized glucose tier (0-3), BMI obesity tier (0-4), and high parity flag (0-1). Ranges 0-8, summarizing multi-factor metabolic risk.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates multiple risk dimensions into a single ordinal score, enabling efficient single-split decisions on combined risk.
features.formula: np.where(plas < 100, 0, np.where(plas < 126, 1, np.where(plas < 200, 2, 3))) + np.where(mass <= 0, 0, np.where(mass < 25, 1, np.where(mass < 30, 2, np.where(mass < 35, 3, 4)))) + np.where(preg >= 6, 1, 0)

features.name: blood_pressure_abnormal
features.description: Semantic assessment of blood pressure status: 0=missing/zero (pres=0), 1=low (<60), 2=normal (60-89), 3=elevated/hypertensive (>=90). Captures clinical blood pressure categories relevant to cardiovascular-metabolic risk.
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes clinical blood pressure categories as ordinal integers for direct tree splitting on hypertension risk.

features.name: age_pregnancy_burden
features.description: Ratio of pregnancies to age, scaled by 10. Captures reproductive burden relative to age - high values indicate many pregnancies at younger age, a distinct risk profile.
features.expected_model_benefit: Interaction between parity and age captures age-adjusted reproductive burden, providing a nonlinear feature for tree splits.
